paragraphs.en: Words have the power to inspire, to heal, and to transform lives.
paragraphs.cn: 语言有力量去激励、去治愈、去改变人生。

paragraphs.en: Every word we speak carries energy that can either uplift or discourage others.
paragraphs.cn: 我们说的每一个词都携带着能量，可以激励或打击他人。

paragraphs.en: When we choose our words carefully, we create a world of understanding and compassion.
paragraphs.cn: 当我们谨慎选择言辞时，我们创造了一个充满理解和同情的世界。

paragraphs.en: The most beautiful words are those spoken with sincerity and love.
paragraphs.cn: 最美丽的语言是那些带着真诚和爱说出的。
